_threshold_docs.format: [boundary_low, boundary_high] — flag severity interpolated 0-1 between boundaries
_threshold_docs.Low_SNR: INVERTED: [good_threshold, bad_threshold] — high SNR maps to low flag severity, low SNR maps to high severity

_readability_relief_docs.purpose: Small bonus for low-gain but clearly readable ECG when NK morphology and coverage stay good.
_readability_relief_docs.legacy_mode: Set max_bonus to 0.0 to restore pre-relief behaviour.
_readability_relief_docs.support_threshold: Readability support value where relief starts.
_readability_relief_docs.support_full: Readability support value where relief reaches full strength.
_readability_relief_docs.morph_threshold: Morphology support value where relief starts.
_readability_relief_docs.morph_full: Morphology support value where relief reaches full strength.
_readability_relief_docs.noise_reference: Noise_Artifact level treated as full penalty pressure for relief scaling.
_readability_relief_docs.low_snr_reference: Low_SNR level treated as full penalty pressure for relief scaling.

_baseline_visibility_docs.purpose: Supplement residual LF-power drift with visible baseline movement inside the displayed window.
_baseline_visibility_docs.chunk_sec: Median is computed per chunk of this duration inside each analysis window.
_baseline_visibility_docs.good_ratio: Visible baseline ratio where drift penalty starts.
_baseline_visibility_docs.bad_ratio: Visible baseline ratio where visible drift reaches full severity.
